basis.quote: extended for a further period of 10 years

material_gaps: Held text of IRA s.2 and allotment trust status not held; 10-year extension end date not fixed by the order text.
rationale: EO 5466 (22 Oct 1930, Hoover) extended trust periods expiring in 1930 for 10 years, excepting allotment 902. The end depends on each period's expiry date and on later general trust extensions (IRA 1934), none held; the number search found only the order itself.
